reason: Refuted as a separate new item. It is mostly a duplicate, and its one unique part would almost certainly give no information. (1) The part that says 'gate post-deadline items on the private split' repeats R12P-3 from this same round (scan_hyp_post_deadline.json: late-submission bed, one late sub per item, budget 15, read = private delta vs #37 >= +0.001). So the novelty claim ('0 hits for late sub') is false within round 12. (2) The unique part is the K1 exp58t factorial arm, which adds almost nothing to the C1-C4 private reads we get for free on 30 Sep. K1 and #35 give the same output (K1 dummy sha == exp57b dummy, CONTEXT l.1818) unless x138's own 7.5 h REPAIR_DEADLINE fired in #35. Latency bounds runtime from above: #34 L <= 6.46 h, twin L (6.69, 6.87] h, K2 L (7.36, 7.54] h, so lowrefine + safetail cost ~0.3-0.4 h and #35 ran for roughly <= 7.1-7.2 h, under 7.5 h. If the deadline fired anyway, it touches only the last-sorted clips, at <~1e-4 (CONTEXT V4 row 5). The API private_score is a 3-decimal string, and a late sub has no LB rank, so no sub-display read is possible. K1 - #35 therefore very likely displays 0.000, which our own reading rule calls uninformative. C1' = K1 - #34 equals C1 = #35 - #34 in that case. The 'clean interaction' C2 - C1' is a difference of two 3-dp differences where lowrefine alone has prior P(=0) ~0.8 (C3), so it cannot be read. (3) Competition gain is 0 by construction. Feasibility itself is fine: K1 v1 is already pushed and dummy-gated (16/16 PASS), nothing happens before 30 Sep, so R8 and R1-R10 are not touched, and each late sub still needs a user OK. But late submissions for this competition are unverified, and R12P-3 already carries that check.
fix: Do not add a separate 'post-deadline item 9 factorial'. Merge it into R12P-3 as ONE conditional arm, pre-registered now. Late-submit K1 exp58t v1 (vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp58t-x138-safe, no rebuild, user OK required) only if the 30 Sep read shows C1 = #35 - #34 <= 0 while C2 = #37 - #38 > 0 at 3 dp. That pattern is the only one where the possible #35 7.5 h degrade could explain a disagreement. Read it as: K1 - #34 > 0 = the confound explains C1; K1 - #34 <= 0 = the insertion does not transfer on the plain x138 stack. Drop the interaction contrast (C2 - C1') and the stand-alone 'K1 - #35 measures the degrade' goal. Its late sub counts against R12P-3's budget of 15.
realistic_gain: 0 on the competition (post-deadline, finals #37 + #38 fixed). Epistemic: with probability ~0.8-0.9 the K1 arm reads 0.000 vs #35 and adds nothing over the free C1-C4 reads. It helps only in the C1 <= 0 / C2 > 0 case (prior ~0.1-0.2), at a cost of one ~7-7.5 h hidden run and one user OK.
